summary: Backend-only testing for Complaint Intake app. Created pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covering health, extract (text/file/no-input/oversized), save+list, and chat. All 8/8 tests passed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Gemini 2.5 Flash via Emergent Universal LLM key works end-to-end; extraction correctly returned customer_name, product_name, batch_number (B12345), complaint_type, initial_severity, and priority. Save persists to PostgreSQL and returns id + status='Pending Triage'; subsequent GET /api/complaints includes the saved row. Chat returns a non-empty reply and rejects empty messages with 400.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: File size check happens AFTER awaiting file.read() into memory. For very large uploads this loads full bytes into RAM before rejecting; consider streaming with a running total or reading in chunks and short-circuiting. Not a functional bug (413 is still returned), just a resource-safety enhancement.
server.py: Uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup') — FastAPI recommends the lifespan context manager. Non-blocking, cosmetic.

server.py: The 'file' field in the endpoint signature is Optional[UploadFile], but when the multipart body has no file part FastAPI may still create an empty UploadFile with filename=''. Current code handles it because parse_file returns '' for unknown extensions and empty content, and the final 'if not source_text.strip()' catches it — verified by the 'no input' test returning 400 as expected.

extractor.py: SYSTEM_PROMPT/LLM output is trusted without schema validation beyond key coercion; malformed JSON silently falls back to empty strings. Consider logging when _coerce_json fails so real LLM regressions are observable.

db.py: id is a plain autoincrement Integer — fine for a single-instance PoC but consider UUIDs if this ever runs behind multiple writers. Also created_at server_default would be safer than Python-side default.
No CORS_ORIGINS whitelist configured (uses '*'); acceptable for demo but not for production.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ prefixed complaint row inserted into the complaints table via /api/complaints/save (batch_number=TEST_B12345, customer_name=TEST_Acme Pharma). Not cleaned up — safe to leave; visible in list endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and are parallel-safe (pytest-xdist load-scope). BASE_URL is read from /app/frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. LLM extraction requires EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env (currently set). The oversized-file test constructs a ~10MB payload in-memory and takes a few seconds. If Gemini quota is exhausted, extract/chat tests will fail with llm_error — check backend logs at /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log.
